title: CUBE Registry Per-Task Sample
description: Schema for ONE line of a results/<cube-id>/<id>.samples.jsonl.gz bundle: one row per task/episode, eval-level only (no trajectory blobs). Intentionally lenient (additionalProperties: true) so the producing harness can carry extra eval fields without breaking submission — the registry pins only the fields it verifies. `score` is the one the consistency check averages to re-derive the summary's results.avg_score.

score.description: Per-task score. The verifier averages the non-null scores to re-derive results.avg_score.
